name: Robinhood Chain
notes: ELPIDA V2.3 launchpad on Robinhood Chain (Malik, 23 November 2026): every fee split 50% traders (monthly EWPR airdrop in USDG) / 30% creator / 20% treasury; no flywheel or holder-reward vault. New launches go here; tokens of the V2.0 launchpad keep their own split. Same treasury Safe, keeper, guardian, PoolManager, feed and dollar as the Robinhood Chain V2.0 plan. Robinhood Chain mainnet (chain 4663, Arbitrum Orbit, ETH gas). The plan dollar is USDG (Paxos Global Dollar, 6 decimals; Paxos docs), not USDC: Robinhood Chain settles in USDG (Malik, 10-11 Nov). PoolManager: Uniswap v4 deployments page (Robinhood Chain: 4663). usdFeed: Chainlink ETH / USD standard proxy from docs.chain.link price feed addresses, Robinhood Chain Mainnet (not the SVR proxy); its heartbeat is not published there, so feedMaxAge allows a day and `check` prints the live age. Same treasury Safe address, keeper and guardian as Base (18 Nov 2026): add Robinhood Chain to the Elpida Treasury Safe in the Safe app before `check`. dailyLaunchCap 1000 and minFeeBps 100 follow Malik's Base decision.
